D5_SINGLE_WRITER.note: Each EpisodeSynthesizer instance processes one run synchronously; this matrix does not introduce same-run concurrent writers.

tests.name: D1_CANONICAL_REPLAY
tests.interpretation: Ten single-writer canonical replays must agree on membership, revisions, late records, and full bundle.

tests.name: D2_DELIVERY_ORDER
tests.variants: reverse, edr_first, ndr_first, alternating when possible, 3 seeded shuffles
tests.interpretation: Reports raw delivery-order equality separately; arrival-order canonicalization must reproduce the baseline.

tests.name: D3_INGEST_DELAY
tests.interpretation: Delay outcomes are recorded at threshold boundaries; pass means each scenario executed without crashing.

tests.name: D4_DUPLICATES
tests.interpretation: Byte-identical duplicate membership must be idempotent; conflicting event-id behavior is observed.

tests.name: D5_SINGLE_WRITER
tests.interpretation: Architecture enforces a single writer per run; only independent runs may be parallelized.
